metadata.title: Bo Melton (back) questionable to play Sunday
metadata.description: Bo Melton (back) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
metadata.analysis: Melton is uncertain to play on Sunday due to the back injury that is currently bothering him. If he's ruled out ahead of game time, Savion Williams may see more work as a result of his absence, though not likely enough to be a relevant fantasy option.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - No practice Thursday
metadata.description: Melton (back) did not participate in practice Thursday, Weston Hodkiewicz of the Packers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Melton did not practice on Wednesday or Thursday due to a back injury that likely occurred in the Packers' win over the Cowboys in Week 6. The 27-year-old will likely need to practice in some capacity to have a chance at playing Sunday against the Lions.

metadata.title: Bo Melton (back) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Bo Melton (back) missed Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: A back injury left Melton sidelined at Green Bay's first practice of the week on Wednesday. It may leave him sidelined for Week 7 as well, which would possibly lead to more work for Savion Williams (ankle) this week.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Nursing back injury
metadata.description: Melton (back) was a limited participant in Wednesday's walkthrough practice, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Melton may have tweaked his back during the Packers' Week 6 win against the Cowboys, when he played 34 snaps (18 on offense, 16 on special teams) and drew a 37-yard pass interference penalty late in the second quarter before adding a tackle on kickoff coverage. He'll have two more practices to increase his participation to avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Lions.

metadata.title: Bo Melton catches three passes in Week 5
metadata.description: Bo Melton caught three of his four targets for 20 yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
metadata.analysis: Melton has been minimally involved in the Green Bay passing attack to this point, finishing with less than two targets in four of the first five games. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Sees uptick in offensive snaps vs. Atlanta
metadata.description: Melton logged 21 of 66 offensive snaps during Thursday's 35-14 loss to the Falcons but did not catch his only target. He also recorded two tackles and turned two kickoff returns into 46 yards.
metadata.analysis: Melton played a total of 42 snaps Thursday, split evenly between special teams and offense, and his offensive snap count was fourth-most among Packers wide receivers. Despite the spike in playing time, Melton shouldn't factor into the team's offensive game plan unless a larger role opens up for the 2022 seventh-rounder due to the absence of one or multiple wide receivers.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Full participant in Monday's estimation
metadata.description: Melton (neck) was a full participant in Monday's estimated practice, Tom Silverstein of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
metadata.analysis: Melton exited last Sunday's overtime win over the Jets early with a stinger. The kick returner is expected to be all set to practice at full capacity Tuesday as the team prepares for Thursday's primetime game against the Falcons.

metadata.title: Bo Melton sees one target in Week 2
metadata.description: Bo Melton failed to catch his only target in the Packers' 20-17 win over the New York Jets in Week 2.
metadata.analysis: Melton saw minimal involvement as part of an underwhelming Green Bay passing attack, finishing last on the team in targets in the win. The wideout can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 3 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Leaves game with stinger
metadata.description: Melton (neck) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against the Jets.
metadata.analysis: Melton may have picked up the injury during the second half, and he's being evaluated to determine whether he can return to Sunday's game. Skyy Moore and J. Michael Sturdivant are in line for a small uptick in offensive snaps for as long as Melton is out of the game.

metadata.title: Bo Melton signs with Packers' active roster
metadata.description: WR Bo Melton signed to the Packers' active roster.
metadata.analysis: Melton was released by Green Bay last week. He'll add depth to its wide receiver room.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Signs with active roster
metadata.description: The Packers signed Melton to the active roster Monday.
metadata.analysis: Melton was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster for Sunday's loss to the Vikings. The wide receiver played 27 total snaps, catching his sole target for 10 yards on one of his seven offensive plays. The wide receiver played in 16 regular-season games for the Packers in 2025, logging four receptions for 107 yards and a touchdown as well as five rushing attempts for 35 yards.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Cleared to return
metadata.description: Melton (cramps) has returned to Sunday's game against the Vikings, per the CBS Sports broadcast.
metadata.analysis: Melton briefly left Sunday's game due to cramping, but he was back in the game in the fourth quarter and returned a kickoff for 19 yards. Most of Melton's playing time this year figures to be on special teams as a returner.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Exits game with cramps
metadata.description: Melton (cramps) is questionable to return to Sunday's game against Minnesota.
metadata.analysis: Melton hauled in his lone target for 10 yards and turned three kickoff returns into 105 yards prior to his exit. Kaleb Johnson figures to be the primary returner on kickoffs if Melton is not cleared to return.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Elevated for Week 1
metadata.description: The Packers elevated Melton from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday.
metadata.analysis: Melton is all set to suit up for Sunday's game against the Vikings as a temporary replacement for Savion Williams (ankle) as he recovers from his injury on IR. Melton played in 16 regular-season games for the Packers in 2025, catching four passes for 107 yards and a touchdown. The wide receiver also played 186 special teams snaps, making him a versatile elevation for the Week 1 divisional showdown.

metadata.title: Bo Melton - Cut, but expected back on practice squad
metadata.description: The Packers released Melton on Friday.
metadata.analysis: Because Melton is a vested veteran and not subject to waivers at this point in the season, he's expected to sign back on Green Bay's practice squad, from which the team will be able to elevate him Saturday ahead of Sunday's game at Minnesota. Through three NFL campaigns, the wide receiver has posted a combined 28-416-2 line on 54 targets in 38 regular-season contests.

metadata.title: Bo Melton released by Packers
metadata.description: The Packers released WR Bo Melton.
metadata.analysis: Melton made the move back to being a full-time wide receiver this offseason. He will figure to seek another opportunity.
